SASBDB entry SASDMU4  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDMU4/)

Publication: Belorusova et al. (2016), Biochemistry 55, 2084
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.biochem.5b01122

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDMU4.dat   the curve (columns q, I, error)
  SASDMU4_fit1.fit              the CRYSOL fit of "fit1"
  SASDMU4_fit1_model1.pdb: RXR-alpha LBD homodimer with 183 crystal waters; the .dat is in 1/nm
Only fit1 is used. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDMU4/ (buffer, temperature and wavelength: see its header comments).
Added 2026-11-15; not yet run.
